# Claude Code Plugin Marketplace

A private marketplace registry for Claude Code plugins.

## Plugins

| Plugin | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **todoist** | Manage Todoist tasks, projects, sections, labels, and comments |
| **jira** | Read-only Jira Cloud queries for issues, sprints, and team activity |
| **git-logs** | Explore git history and summarize development activity |

## Structure

- `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` — Plugin registry listing all available plugins and their source repositories.

Each plugin source points to its own dedicated GitHub repository.
